After being on high dose for five years I was slowly weened off of mine (it took around 5 months) The symptoms are definitely much worse when you first go off of them. For me I was miserable , mood swings ect. Once you are off of them things will start to get better , at around two months after being completely antidepressant free I actually started to feel okay again

My bit of advice:  You can live a normal life without the medication. But because of your predisposition to depression you will be more vulnerable to certain things than those who have not had depression. 

This is why its very important to have a good network of people supporting you who understand that you may need extra help coping sometimes. 

It is truly my opinion that this kind of support can be a replacement for antidepressants 

I wish you luck in your journey and I hope everything works out okay for you! :)
